name: background.raised-by-belief.name
editNote: Reserved Material removed: the example Lore subcategory that named a deity replaced with a generic description; accepted: the book (p.88) makes this background's attribute boost, trained skill, and Lore subcategory ALL depend on which deity the character reveres (their Divine Attribute and Divine Skill) -- there is no fixed value to fill in until that choice is made at character creation, which is exactly why boosts is free/free and skills is empty rather than a specific pick. The record's own text and lore field spell out the deity-dependent rule in full; the schema has no notion of a deity-conditional boost or skill, so this is the correct, complete representation of what the book actually specifies.
